scope: Textual semantic review of real offline skill executions; no video generation, inference, audio analysis or physical-feasibility verification.

runs.execution_type: independent agent given task and skill path; no expected answer
criteria: Camera reaches its specified destination at 3.5s, 0.5s before the 4s turn onset.
The only cut occurs at 5s within the 4–6s turn; the side camera is prepositioned.
Response timing and edit policy are independently selected; camera stillness does not freeze dancers.
World-space direction, angular speed, support foot and clothing inertia continue through the cut.
The component has no fake generation segments or invented media; geometry is explicitly an authored assumption.
Static checks and author semantic attestations are distinguished; the component prose is not automatically semantically verified.
runs.limitations: No field-of-view simulation, actual motion or inferred quality checked.

runs.execution_type: independent agent given task and skill path; no expected answer
criteria: Three 4s/24FPS generations are cropped to three 3s edits; final 9s/30FPS/270 frames are separately computed.
Each prompt starts already in its own sock state, mid-entry at screen right; no in-shot transformation.
The display pose settles by 2s and persists past the retained 3s boundary; actual retained end frames remain to inspect.
The 3s/6s joins intentionally cut from pose to the next entry stride, with no fictitious motion continuity.
One postproduction music track spans the final timeline; no claimed audio file or beat measurement.
Provisional T2VA designs are labeled; missing identity/look assets are not forged into reference bindings.
Draft and missing media/runtime checks remain unresolved; strict rejection is preserved and explained.
runs.static_results: draft exit 0, 0 errors/12 warnings; strict exit 1, 13 errors/0 warnings, expected rejection
runs.limitations: Actual person/look matching, runtime call, crop usability, frame conversion and music assembly are unverified.

runs.execution_type: collection editor executes a complete happy-path exercise; informed, not independent blind run
criteria: An 8s text-only task selects T2VA without fabricated reference assets.
Three contact-triggered changes create four sock patterns and four same-view Shot intervals.
Old pattern persists through lift/descent; new pattern appears at first contact, followed by a visible planted hold.
The left foot supports and stays in place; the right foot performs compact lifts.
24FPS generation boundaries 48/96/144 and 30FPS edit boundaries 60/120/180 are separated.
All 8 seconds, including the final two-second display, are defined; complete silence is explicitly requested.
Case checks attest to prompt/plan review only, without claiming generated frames exist.
runs.limitations: No actual contact, texture cut, support-foot stability or output-frame conversion checked.
